subject: Glutton
status: REJECTED by Jacob on 10 Oct 2026 after visual review: disliked the overall appearance and slumped swollen shape. Preserve for history; not an approved art reference.
prompt:
Create ONE fresh original character concept for GLUTTON, a dark astral cult survivor in the game Kindred Siege. This is a substantial redesign, not a variation of a previous character. The owner wants an almost completely alien transformed being with an enormous swollen body, dark ceremonial cloth and polished volcanic-glass armour, gorgeous corrupted skin and a restrained intentional black haze. He serves as the camp's ARMOUR AND BODY-AUGMENT specialist. First appearance review, no combat scene.

CRITICAL SILHOUETTE AND ANATOMY:
An immense, swollen, pear-shaped living body with asymmetrical masses, a high hunched back and a huge drooping abdomen; width nearly equals seated height. Two thick heavy arms emerge from high sloping shoulders, tapering into surprisingly long, precise nonhuman fingers. Two short powerful legs partly visible beneath black lower drapery. This is profoundly transformed astral anatomy, not a muscular human with a fat belly and not a stock green plague demon. He sits with enormous patient gravity upon a plain low dark stone camp plinth, torso and outline unobstructed by furniture. His tiny recessed HEAD is almost swallowed between the shoulders, rotated slightly toward the viewer. Original head anatomy: a smooth tilted oval nacre cranial plate like a weathered seed casing grown as his skull, no helmet. Two asymmetrical deep oblique eye fissures under soft heavy folds, with tiny dull antique-gold irises that do NOT glow. A short off-centre lip crease low on the face suggests secretive patient amusement. No conventional human nose or external ears. Intellect and agency apparent through his gaze and delicate hand action.
ABSOLUTELY NO third eye, exposed/transparent brain, dreadlocks, beard braids, split-arch crown, halo, ornate headgear, handsome humanoid leader face, six-pack or identical royal tabard. These belong exclusively to a DIFFERENT character, not Glutton. No horns, tusks, fly emblems, seven-dot marks, scythe, belly mouth, extra limbs or recognisable Warhammer character parts.

MATERIAL CONNECTION TO HIS ORIGINAL PEOPLE:
Living opalescent NACRE SKIN, like deep layered mother-of-pearl rather than reptile scales or human flesh. Skin tone is smoked pearl, bruised muted aubergine, pewter and charcoal. Broad beautiful continuous swollen surfaces catch low soft pearlescent iridescence; a few stretched shelllike micro-plates and organically grown structural ridges recall his species' cybernetic origin. Under the translucent surface, fine black branching corruption is visible like ink trapped under porcelain. His anatomy has grown around sombre ancient-gold implant seams and obsidian load-bearing ribs, biological integration rather than a costume or robot armour suit. No polished gold outlines everywhere. No neon, luminous circuitry, rainbow glow, saturated green, magenta, bright cyan, cosmic glitter or galaxy-print skin.

ROT, BEAUTY AND ENDURANCE:
Most visible skin remains eerily beautiful, but two LOCALIZED areas — one massive flank and the underside of a forearm — have overt grotesque decay: softened delaminating nacre, puckered cavities, swollen pearl-coloured blisters, dark necrotic fibrous tissue and black weeping seams. The decay is unmistakable, not merely tasteful little cracks. Integrate it organically into the body. No red blood, exposed intestines, severed parts, wet violence or maggots pasted everywhere. Beauty and rot coexist in this same material. He is an ancient sentient survivor, patient and subtly kindly in manner despite his disturbing form. Warhammer's Nurgle armies inform MASS, grotesque endurance, decay/regrowth and incongruous calm only; invent an original dark astral design, never a direct miniature copy.

CULT REGALIA:
Approximately half of the body surface visible, as a loose art balance rather than exact nudity percentage. Groin fully covered, no erotic styling. Heavy true BLACK cloth (aubergine visible only in the folds), a weighty asymmetrical mantle draped from one shoulder over his back, broad lower wrap arranged in deep slow folds. A few sculpted pieces of polished black volcanic glass protect the opposite shoulder and one forearm; edges carry very restrained tarnished ancient-gold repairs. Shape these pieces specifically for his enormous abnormal anatomy. No tall collar framing him as an ordinary wizard, no cape wings, no duplicated leader cape, no leather blacksmith apron. Small worn broken cult sigil as a dull seal on the wrap, not a giant glowing logo.

ASTRAL PRESENCE AND ROLE:
Sparse charcoal-black mist seeps from his skin creases and cloth hems, curls in two deliberate low paths toward his open hands, then settles close to the ground. It has apparent intent, not a gigantic FX cloud, neon aura, fire or tentacles. The mist must never obscure the body design. In one delicate hand he holds a modest cracked cuirass plate, the other guides a thin black filament into a pearl repair seam. This single understated action suggests his armour/augmentation craft; no workbench full of clutter, holograms, bottles, lab-coat, cauldron or battle weapon. His exact Sovereign-inflicted amputation/injury remains open, so do not design a missing limb or specific injury narrative on this pass.

COMPOSITION AND FINISH:
A high-quality dark fantasy character design painting with controlled realism, tactile materials, subtle brush texture and clear measured shapes. Mood: ancient, astral, beautiful and deeply unsettling, no cheerful shopkeeper or cartoon. Wide concept plate: LEFT about two-thirds one complete seated figure seen three-quarter front, all huge silhouette visible; RIGHT one face close-up above one corrupted-skin-and-hand detail, both matching exactly. Neutral smoke-grey background LIGHT ENOUGH to separate black regalia; soft cool broad light to show material with a restrained warm antique-gold bounce, no bright backlit VFX. Keep the dark character readable, don't crush shadows. Tiny heading 'GLUTTON' and subheading 'ARMOUR / BODY AUGMENTS'. No extra alternate characters, no long labels, no false gameplay description.
